CURRENT ATTESTATION for the [operator-attested] gates criterion — SUPERSEDES the earlier patchset-1 evidence, which the completion verifier correctly refused as stale.

The verifier's objection was exactly right and is recorded here so the trail is honest: the prior attestation on this ticket named a Verified +1 that PREDATED the CI failure, and a later comment recorded patchset 2 taking Verified -1 twice (deterministic, not a flake) from the latent test-infra defect in reconciler test scaffolding. Neither comment recorded the outcome after the fix. This comment supplies that missing outcome.

WHAT CHANGED SINCE: bug 9f0b (change 1050, "9f0b: unify by-path test module identity") was reviewed, verified and SUBMITTED to main at 2026-07-30 18:28:24 UTC (status MERGED). This feature branch was then rebased onto the updated origin/main — which had advanced 32 commits, several inside the same LLM subsystem — resolving two conflicts: a genuine import union in src/rebar/llm/runner.py (both `infer_provider`, used at the usage-log call site introduced upstream, and `cache_settings_for`/`capabilities_for` from f184 are live, so both imports were kept) and the GENERATED count line in docs/env-vars.md (regenerated with `python scripts/gen_env_registry.py` rather than hand-edited, since a CI drift gate guards that file; it resolved to 135 = main's 133 + this story's 2 Bedrock vars).

INDEPENDENT CI EVIDENCE (the Gerrit change id + vote outcome the criterion asks for):
- Change 1043 ("2932: add a first-class Bedrock provider"), PATCHSET 3, commit 099c315ed272fae802649fd20b842d5108600180.
- Verified +1 by the rebar CI bot at 2026-07-30 19:19:15 UTC — SUCCESS, run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/30571226453
- LLM-Review +1 by the rebar review bot at 2026-07-30 19:08:36 UTC — PASS, 3 advisory findings, none blocking.
This is the CURRENT patchset (ps3), i.e. the one carrying this story's new tests, on top of the merged 9f0b fix. The ps2 Verified -1 is superseded and no longer describes any patchset under review.

LOCAL EVIDENCE on the same tree (worktree /Users/joeoakhart/rebar-wt-provider-seam, branch feat/llm-provider-seam, HEAD 7db7940e681bd3e3a7916fabcad6f9ce1eec7997, with this story's commit at 099c315ed):
- `make lint` — clean (ruff check + format-check), exit 0.
- `make typecheck` — clean (mypy), exit 0.
- FULL suite `python -m pytest -q -x -n auto` — 8049 passed, 72 skipped, 17 warnings, 0 failed, in 430.72s.
Run AFTER the rebase and BEFORE the push, precisely so a semantic conflict from the 32 upstream commits would surface locally rather than as a CI red. It did not: local and CI agree.

So both halves of the criterion now hold on the SAME artifact: the local gates pass on the tree, and an independent CI run on the corresponding Gerrit patchset voted Verified +1.
